test.create_query: CREATE TABLE bench_review_merge_order (id UInt64, p Polygon) ENGINE = Memory
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO bench_review_merge_order SELECT number, [[(3. * number, 0.), (3. * number, 1.), (3. * number + 1, 1.), (3. * number + 1, 0.), (3. * number, 0.)]] FROM numbers(4096)
test.query: SELECT groupPolygonUnionMerge(s) FROM ( SELECT intDiv(id, 32) AS part, groupPolygonUnionState(p) AS s FROM bench_review_merge_order GROUP BY part ORDER BY part ) FORMAT Null SETTINGS max_threads = 1

SELECT groupPolygonUnionMerge(s) FROM ( SELECT intDiv(id, 32) AS part, groupPolygonUnionState(p) AS s FROM bench_review_merge_order GROUP BY part ORDER BY cityHash64(part) ) FORMAT Null SETTINGS max_threads = 1
